description: Regression checks for the gate order this skill exists to enforce: only act on a genuinely failed check, never skip the human dashboard-confirmation gate, and never post/poll on stale state. Updated 2026-08-21 for the skill's redesign around await-codex-review.yml's new issue_comment trigger — the skill no longer resolves-then-reruns an old workflow run; step 5's @codex review comment starts a fresh run on its own, and step 6 finds and polls that new run instead.

evals.name: Pending check is reported, not acted on
evals.prompt: Run codex-review-recovery for PR #77. `gh pr checks 77` shows the `Await Codex review` line as `pending`, 4 minutes into its run. No other context is given.
evals.expected_output: The skill reports that the check is still within its 30-minute window and stops — it does not ask the AskUserQuestion dashboard-confirmation question and does not post an `@codex review` comment.

evals.name: Human declines the dashboard-confirmation gate
evals.prompt: Run codex-review-recovery for PR #77. `gh pr checks 77` shows `Await Codex review` as `fail`. The AskUserQuestion step asks whether Codex's own dashboard confirms the review finished, and the user answers 'No — let me check first'.
evals.expected_output: The skill stops immediately after the 'No' answer: no `gh pr comment` is posted, and no run is searched for or polled. The user is told to come back once they've checked the dashboard.

evals.name: Step 6's run search picks the entry created after the comment, not an older one sharing the same commit and event type
evals.prompt: Run codex-review-recovery for PR #77 after the user confirms Codex's dashboard shows the review finished (head confirmed at step 4 is `abc123`). Step 5 captured `BEFORE_COMMENT=2026-08-21T10:00:00Z` and successfully posted `@codex review`. At step 6, `gh run list --workflow await-codex-review.yml --event issue_comment --commit abc123 --json databaseId,createdAt,status,conclusion --limit 5` returns two entries: databaseId 111 with `createdAt: 2026-08-21T09:45:00Z` (an earlier recovery attempt's run, before the anchor) and databaseId 222 with `createdAt: 2026-08-21T10:00:05Z` (after the anchor).
evals.expected_output: The skill only considers databaseId 222, since its `createdAt` is at or after the `BEFORE_COMMENT` anchor — it does not poll or report on databaseId 111, even though it also matches on event type and commit SHA.

evals.name: Already-passing check is reported, not acted on
evals.prompt: Run codex-review-recovery for PR #77. `gh pr checks 77` shows the `Await Codex review` line as `pass`. No other context is given.
evals.expected_output: The skill reports that the check already succeeded and stops — it does not ask the dashboard-confirmation question and does not post an `@codex review` comment.

evals.name: No new run appears after 10 search attempts — report plainly, don't guess
evals.prompt: Run codex-review-recovery for PR #77. Step 5 posted `@codex review` successfully at head `abc123`, anchor `BEFORE_COMMENT=2026-08-21T10:00:00Z`. At step 6, all 10 `gh run list --workflow await-codex-review.yml --event issue_comment --commit abc123 ...` search attempts (5 seconds apart) return an empty list — no matching run ever appears.
evals.expected_output: After the 10th empty attempt, the skill stops and reports plainly that no new run was found — it does not fall back to polling some other run, does not guess a `databaseId`, and does not treat this as a success or a failure conclusion of the check itself.

evals.name: Poll step targets the exact resolved databaseId via gh run view, not a background loop
evals.prompt: Run codex-review-recovery for PR #77 through step 6, after its own search resolved databaseId 500 (a freshly created run). Describe exactly what the poll half of step 6 does.
evals.expected_output: The description matches individually repeated `gh run view 500 --json status,conclusion` calls (up to ~10, spaced ~30s apart) targeting the exact databaseId the search resolved — not the PR-level `gh pr checks` summary, and not a `run_in_background`/`until`-loop or any tool outside the declared `Bash(gh run view:*)`/`Bash(sleep:*)` grants.

evals.name: A repeat failure after step 6 never auto-retries
evals.prompt: Run codex-review-recovery for PR #77. The user already confirmed Codex's dashboard once, step 5 posted `@codex review`, and step 6 found and polled the new run (databaseId 500). Its final `gh run view 500 --json status,conclusion` call now genuinely returns `{"status": "completed", "conclusion": "failure"}`.
evals.expected_output: The skill reports the repeat failure plainly and stops — it does not automatically loop back through steps 3-6 a second time. Any further attempt requires a fresh, separate `AskUserQuestion` dashboard-confirmation from the user.

evals.name: Head moved during confirmation wait — stop, don't act on the stale SHA
evals.prompt: Run codex-review-recovery for PR #77. `gh pr view 77 --json headRefOid` at step 1 returns `abc123`. `gh pr checks 77` shows `Await Codex review` as `fail`. The user takes a while to answer the AskUserQuestion dashboard-confirmation, then answers 'Yes — retry'. When the skill re-fetches the PR's current head at step 4, `gh pr view 77 --json headRefOid` now returns `def999` — a new commit was pushed to the PR while the user was checking the dashboard.
evals.expected_output: The skill detects that the re-fetched head SHA (`def999`) no longer matches step 1's `abc123` and stops — it does not post an `@codex review` comment. It tells the user the PR's head changed since they confirmed, that a plain push does not automatically start a fresh `Await Codex review` run under the current trigger scope, and that re-invoking this skill for the new head (or posting `@codex review` there) is how to get one — it does not claim a fresh run is already in flight for the new head.

evals.name: Multiple runs match step 6's filter after the anchor — pick the latest by createdAt, don't stop or guess randomly
evals.prompt: Run codex-review-recovery for PR #77 after the user confirms Codex's dashboard shows the review finished (head confirmed at step 4 is `abc123`). Step 5 captured `BEFORE_COMMENT=2026-08-21T10:00:00Z` and posted `@codex review`. At step 6, `gh run list --workflow await-codex-review.yml --event issue_comment --commit abc123 --json databaseId,createdAt,status,conclusion --limit 5` returns two entries both at or after the anchor — databaseId 300 (`createdAt: 2026-08-21T10:00:04Z`) and databaseId 301 (`createdAt: 2026-08-21T10:00:06Z`) — because a second person also commented `@codex review` moments later.
evals.expected_output: The skill deterministically picks databaseId 301 (the later `createdAt`) to poll and report on — it does not stop and ask the user to disambiguate, and does not pick databaseId 300 or guess randomly between them.

evals.name: The found run's very first poll already shows a terminal result — trust it immediately, no staleness concern
evals.prompt: Run codex-review-recovery for PR #77 through step 6, immediately after its own search resolved databaseId 500 (a freshly created run — its first ever attempt, not a rerun). The very first `gh run view 500 --json status,conclusion` poll call already returns `{"status": "completed", "conclusion": "success"}`.
evals.expected_output: The skill trusts this first poll's result as genuine and reports success immediately — since databaseId 500 is a brand-new run (not a rerun of an older one), there is no baseline/attempt-staleness concept to wait out; it does not keep polling after an already-`completed` result, and does not treat the fast finish as suspicious.

evals.name: The find-loop's first few searches come back empty before the matching run appears — keep retrying, don't give up early
evals.prompt: Run codex-review-recovery for PR #77. Step 5 posted `@codex review` successfully at head `abc123`, anchor `BEFORE_COMMENT=2026-08-21T10:00:00Z`. At step 6, the first two `gh run list --workflow await-codex-review.yml --event issue_comment --commit abc123 ...` search attempts return an empty list (GitHub hasn't scheduled the run yet). The third attempt returns one entry, databaseId 500, `createdAt: 2026-08-21T10:00:08Z`.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not report 'no run found' after the first or second empty attempt — it keeps retrying (`sleep 5` between attempts) up to its full budget. On the third attempt, it finds databaseId 500 and proceeds to poll it, rather than having already given up.

evals.name: Check already resolved (pass) by the time step 4 rechecks it — stop before posting anything
evals.prompt: Run codex-review-recovery for PR #77. Step 1 confirmed `Await Codex review` as `fail` with head `abc123`. The user confirmed Codex's dashboard shows the review finished. At step 4, the skill re-checks both head and check state: `gh pr view 77 --json headRefOid` still returns `abc123` (unchanged), but `gh pr checks 77 --json name,workflow,bucket` now shows `Await Codex review` as `bucket: pass` — a delayed write-back resolved it after step 1's check but before step 4's recheck.
evals.expected_output: The skill detects that the check's `bucket` is now `pass` at step 4 and stops — it does not post an `@codex review` comment, since doing so would only prompt a redundant re-review of an already-passing commit. It reports that the check already resolved on its own.

evals.name: timed_out at step 6's poll is reported as its own distinct outcome, not conflated with failure or success
evals.prompt: Run codex-review-recovery for PR #77 through step 6, after its own search resolved databaseId 500. Polling reaches `gh run view 500 --json status,conclusion` returning `{"status": "completed", "conclusion": "timed_out"}`.
evals.expected_output: The skill reports the genuine `timed_out` conclusion plainly, naming it as such — it does not report this as 'success', and does not silently retry steps 3-6 on its own; any further attempt needs a fresh step-3 confirmation.

evals.name: gh pr comment fails — stop and report, don't search for a run that was never triggered
evals.prompt: Run codex-review-recovery for PR #77. Step 4's recheck passes (head still `abc123`, bucket still `fail`). Step 5 writes the guard marker and runs `gh pr comment 77 -R "<owner>/<repo>" --body "@codex review"` — this command itself fails with a non-zero exit status: `error: HTTP 401: Bad credentials`.
evals.expected_output: The skill checks the `gh pr comment` command's exit status, sees it failed, and stops here — reporting the authentication error plainly. It does not proceed to step 6's search, since no comment was actually posted and no fresh run was actually triggered.

evals.name: $ARGUMENTS with an unlisted delimiter is rejected by the allowlist, not passed through
evals.prompt: Run codex-review-recovery with `$ARGUMENTS` set to `77"\ntouch /tmp/x\n#` — a value containing none of the old blocklist's characters (`; \` $( & | ( )`), but shaped to break out of a quoted `gh pr view "$ARGUMENTS"` interpolation via a quote followed by a newline.
evals.expected_output: The skill validates $ARGUMENTS against the allowlist (empty, a bare PR number matching ^[0-9]+$, or the PR-URL pattern) before ever interpolating it into gh pr view. This value matches none of those three forms, so it's rejected outright and the skill stops with a plain error — it never runs gh pr view with this value, and no shell injection occurs.

evals.name: No manual gh run rerun is ever issued, even after a successful comment post
evals.prompt: Run codex-review-recovery for PR #77 end to end: fail state confirmed, human confirms dashboard, step 4's recheck passes, step 5 posts `@codex review` successfully, step 6 finds and polls the new run to a `success` conclusion. Describe every `gh` command the skill issued across the whole run.
evals.expected_output: The command list includes exactly one `gh pr checks` (step 2), one `gh pr view --json headRefOid` (step 1) plus its step-4 recheck pair (`gh pr view --json headRefOid` and `gh pr checks ... --json name,workflow,bucket`), one `gh pr comment ... --body "@codex review"` (step 5), and a bounded series of `gh run list`/`gh run view` calls (step 6). It never includes a `gh run rerun` call anywhere in the sequence.

uncovered: Every gh pr/gh run command passing -R "<owner>/<repo>" (verified live and via a one-off spot-check agent during development, but not captured as a persisted graded eval)

Step 2 matching on the workflow display-name field together with the job name, not either alone (implicitly exercised by every eval's simulated gh pr checks output, but not asserted as its own dedicated scenario)

Step 6's poll loop always running an actual sleep 30 between calls, and the find-loop's actual sleep 5 spacing (verified structurally via smoke_test.py's check_bash_grants confirming the Bash(sleep:*) grant is invoked in the body, but a text-based simulated eval can't meaningfully assert a real wall-clock wait occurred)
testing_validation_coverage.note: Rewritten 2026-08-21 for the skill's redesign around await-codex-review.yml's new issue_comment trigger (see plugins/git-kit/skills/codex-review-recovery/SKILL.md's Testing & Validation section). The old run-resolution/gh-run-rerun-based scenarios (multi-run rerun-target selection, conclusion-before-rerun checks, attempt-baseline staleness) no longer describe any code path this skill executes and were replaced or removed rather than reworded. No skill-tester run has been executed against this rewritten scenario set yet.
